notes: Fig. 4 is a sketch plan of the whole fortification at about one third of the scale of the fold-out plan Fig. 8, drawn turned about a quarter turn relative to Fig. 8 on the page. The site was located as for Fig. 8: the plans-v1 coordinate (23.6304 N, 70.8407 E) shows no excavation; the excavated citadel is at about 23.6113 N, 70.9173 E (coordinate from the repository site census, GAZETTEER2018). Only structures at the western end of the excavation can be matched, so the six points span about 30 m of a plan about 150 m across; all lie on exposed ancient masonry and the plan draws no modern feature. Points read on Wayback release 8432 (in service 2021-07-21 to 2021-09-28; capture date not reported). No statement of a wall's or a town's orientation was seen while working on this plan.
